title: Rebuild Demo / Tune vehicle impacts
goal: Open F5 > Impacts in a Warthog or tank. Tune how easily aliens are killed or launched, then drive into a patrol.
changes: Four live, saved sliders control minimum impact speed, damage, forward launch and upward launch. Defaults now activate above 1 m/s, deal 30 damage per m/s above that threshold and add stronger forward/upward launch. Gentle stationary contacts and repeated contacts remain protected. Restart once to load these runtime changes. 2026-10-17: the separate Sky Demo shortcut now offers cached billboards and a physical high painterly layer; Rebuild appearance is unchanged. Sky Demo now also provides upper cloud coverage variation and blue haze controls in Ctrl+F3. Nearby terrain now prepares for the full grenade throw before combat and retains that preparation as you stay nearby; crater rebuilding reuses unchanged sections and prepares collision on the terrain worker. Rocket Launcher added on 6 (two shots, R reload), with impact blasts and craters. Actors and crates keep moving during terrain edits.
controls: F5 > Impacts: lower Minimum impact speed for easier punts; raise Damage for easier kills; tune Forward and Upward launch independently. Changes apply immediately to the selected vehicle and save in its vehicle-type tuning file. F5 or Esc closes. E / Square enters or exits. F8 records diagnostics. F1 opens the editor. Controller L1 throws the same terrain grenade as B; nearby elite aliens dive from both. 6: Rocket Launcher. LMB / R2 fire; R / Square reload.
